{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)
num_duplicates = duplicate_patients.sum()
print(f'Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {num_duplicates}')

# Check how many rows have -999 in biomarker_baseline
missing_baseline = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f'Number of rows with biomarker_baseline == -999: {missing_baseline}')

# Check if those rows have valid responded values
df_with_missing_baseline = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999]
print(f'Number of such rows with responded=1: {df_with_missing_baseline["responded"].sum()}')"}
